name: foundation.dns_grant
description: Foundation-issued, FALCON-1024 signed DNS reservation grant. Authorizes a specific recipient (identified by FALCON-1024 public key) to register a foundation-reserved domain name. Bound to recipient by inclusion of `recipient_pubkey` in the signed payload — non-transferable.

domain.description: The reserved domain name this grant authorizes (e.g., 'nike', 'apple').

recipient_pubkey.description: FALCON-1024 public key bytes of the recipient, hex-encoded. Must equal the registering identity's pubkey at chain-write time (otherwise registration is rejected with GrantRecipientMismatch).

valid_until.description: Grant expiry. Registrations after this point are rejected with ExpiredGrant.

dues_paid_until.description: Last paid dues date — used by Phase F.2 CRL revocation when dues lapse. Not enforced by H.1 verification.

issued_at.description: When the foundation signed this grant.

foundation_signature.description: FALCON-1024 detached signature over the canonical signing_payload (domain || 0x00 || recipient_pubkey || 0x00 || valid_until_le || dues_paid_until_le || issued_at_le).

verification.signing_payload_format: [domain UTF-8] || 0x00 || [recipient_pubkey raw bytes] || 0x00 || [valid_until u64 LE seconds] || [dues_paid_until u64 LE seconds] || [issued_at u64 LE seconds]
